_doc: Plugin registry. Install = baked into Docker image. Enable = added to agent config at project level.

oh-my-openagent.description: Adds multi-agent orchestration to OpenCode. Instead of one AI handling everything, this splits complex tasks across specialized agents: Sisyphus retries with stronger models when something fails, Oracle handles hard reasoning, and Librarian manages project context. 'Ultrawork' mode chains them all together for maximum capability.

dcp.description: Keeps your AI context clean by automatically removing old tool outputs that are no longer needed. This saves tokens (and money) during long sessions where the AI has read many files. Recommended for cost-conscious usage.

speckit.description: Enables a 'spec first, code second' workflow. You write a specification describing what you want, and the agent implements it to match. Reduces back-and-forth and helps maintain consistent architecture.

opencode-scheduler.description: Lets the AI schedule recurring tasks — for example, running lint checks every hour, updating dependencies weekly, or generating reports on a schedule. Uses the system's built-in scheduler (systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS).

opencode-gitlab-duo.description: Connects OpenCode to GitLab's AI features (Duo). Enables the agent to work with GitLab merge requests, code suggestions, and CI pipelines. Only useful if your project is hosted on GitLab.

claude-code-review.description: Adds a dedicated code review capability. Claude analyzes your changes for bugs, performance issues, and security concerns, then gives structured feedback with severity ratings and specific suggestions for improvement.

claude-security-guidance.description: Proactive security scanning — checks your code for common vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, insecure authentication, etc.) and suggests hardened alternatives. Helpful for teams that need to meet security compliance requirements.

claude-pr-review.description: Automates pull request reviews — generates summaries of what changed and why, flags breaking changes, checks that tests cover new code, and gives an approve or request-changes recommendation.

claude-hookify.description: Runs Claude Code checks automatically before you commit or push code (via git hooks). Catches issues early so they don't make it to your CI pipeline or code review.
